equity.equity_measurement: Unadjusted bivariate comparisons against reference levels marked in the tables (e.g. White, non-Hispanic; below poverty level; not insured; low SVI); SVI is assigned from respondent ZIP code; 'other and multiple races' groups are collapsed; several cells are flagged as unreliable (**).

notes: Booster receipt was not asked directly; any booster after September 1, 2022 was coded as bivalent, which is a measurement rule and not a procedure. Calibration of weights by age and sex is weighting; the group comparisons are unadjusted T-tests marked in the tables, and no adjusted model is reported.
view_issues: The Summary and Results say interviews were conducted in November–December 2022, but the Methods and table captions give October 30–December 31, 2022.
